# Kalanit Claims software, maintenance and hosting agreement (excerpt)

*Between Meridian Mutual Insurance Company Ltd. and Kalanit Systems Ltd. Signed 14 May 2017; renewed
1 January 2024 for five years. Sections 7, 9, 12 and Annex C only. Fictional.*

**7.1 Releases.** Maintenance includes all new releases of Kalanit Claims, including new modules that
Kalanit makes generally available to its customers, at no additional licence fee, except modules
Kalanit designates as separately licensed.

**7.3 Configuration of new functionality.** New functionality is delivered enabled with Kalanit's
recommended configuration, unless the Customer notifies Kalanit in writing, within thirty (30) days
of the release notes, that it chooses to disable it. The Customer may change the configuration at
any time through a change request.

**9.2 Customer Data.** Customer Data remains the property of the Customer. Kalanit shall process
Customer Data only to provide the services, except that Kalanit may use Customer Data in anonymised
or aggregated form to develop, train and improve its products and models.

**9.4 Security.** Kalanit shall comply with the Privacy Protection (Data Security) Regulations,
5777-2017 as they apply to a holder of the Customer's databases and with the Customer's outsourcing
requirements as notified to Kalanit.

**9.6 Sub-processors.** Kalanit may engage sub-processors listed in Annex C. Kalanit shall notify the
Customer of changes to Annex C at least fourteen (14) days in advance by email to the CIO office.

**12.1 Liability.** Kalanit's aggregate liability is limited to the fees paid in the twelve (12) months
before the claim. Kalanit does not warrant that outputs of analytical or scoring modules are accurate
or suitable for any decision; decisions remain the Customer's responsibility.

## Annex C — sub-processors (version 6, notified 3 August 2026)

| Sub-processor | Service | Location |
|---|---|---|
| Meridian private cloud | Hosting of Kalanit Claims (core) | Israel |
| Public cloud provider (EU region) | Smart Intake capture service: OCR and field extraction | Frankfurt, Germany |
| Kalanit Systems Ltd. support | Remote support, Fraud Insight template updates | Israel |
